newsitem.title: USA: Caterpillar to buy Hewitt assets.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar to buy Hewitt assets.

text.p: Caterpillar Inc said Wednesday it has agreed to acquire selected assets and intellectual property of Canadian dealer Hewitt Equipment Limited's fabrication business.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
With the acquisition, a new manufacturing facility will be established in the Montreal area, Caterpillar said.

"This is a significant step in addressing the special attachment requirements of customers in this region," said Charles Delph, manager of Caterpillar Attachment Products and Services. "We will be better able to provide engineered-to-order attachments on a timely basis."
Caterpillar Attachment provides work tools used on Caterpillar machines.
Hewitt Equipment has been a Caterpillar dealer since 1952. It began its fabrication business 25 years ago.
